canonical_project: Digital Connexion MAA10 Chennai campus, Ambattur
owner: Digital Connexion / Digital Realty / Brookfield / Reliance Industries
notes: Digital Realty announced launch of MAA10 in Chennai on 2024-01-12, describing a 10-acre Ambattur campus capable of up to 100 MW critical IT load. Digital Connexion's earlier release states the first phase offers 20 MW critical capacity.
